name: @pipeworx/mcp-whoisxml

tools.name: whoisxml_whois
tools.description: Current WHOIS for <domain> — registrar, creation/expiry dates, registrant org, name servers, and status. Example: whoisxml_whois({ domain: "google.com", _apiKey: "your-key" })

domain.description: Domain name to look up, e.g. "google.com" (no protocol)

_apiKey.description: WhoisXML API key (get one at whoisxmlapi.com — one key works across all products)

tools.name: whoisxml_whois_history
tools.description: Historical WHOIS records for <domain> — past registrars, registrants, and creation/expiry dates over time. Example: whoisxml_whois_history({ domain: "google.com", _apiKey: "your-key" })

domain.description: Domain name to look up historical WHOIS for, e.g. "google.com"

tools.name: whoisxml_reverse_whois
tools.description: Find domains registered by <email/name/org> — reverse WHOIS lookup returning every domain whose current WHOIS record contains the search term. Example: whoisxml_reverse_whois({ term: "admin@google.com", _apiKey: "your-key" })

term.description: Registrant email, name, or organization to search for, e.g. "admin@google.com" or "Google LLC"

tools.name: whoisxml_dns
tools.description: DNS records for <domain> — A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, and other records with their values and TTLs. Example: whoisxml_dns({ domain: "google.com", _apiKey: "your-key" })

domain.description: Domain name to resolve DNS records for, e.g. "google.com"

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-whoisxml forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the whoisxml pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
